candidate: E: original concise react-v2 prompt with engineering/completion fixes, thinking, 180-second episode
public_trace_findings: The artist-extremum episode repeated the baseline's grounded answer workflow, but when its successful final was deferred it repeatedly returned FinalDecision instead of the required completion action.
The album-play episode correctly identified song 2 and executed play_music(song_id=2), then timed out before completion/finalization.
The private/authenticated tasks continued to lose turns to requester misuse, broad documentation, and missing token propagation.
The original prompt therefore did not solve completion or latency; prior prompt-only revisions were not the sole regression.
decision: Replace completion reprompts with an injected deterministic completion action followed by observed-result verification. Combine it with the opt-in public discovery bootstrap for the next six-task policy run, because neither prompt-only nor time-only candidates earned expansion.
